title: Formable Word Total
summary: Given candidate words and available letters, return the total length of words that can each be formed without reusing a letter.
statement: Evaluate every candidate word independently against the same letter inventory. A letter may be used only as many times as it occurs in the inventory while forming one word; inventory use resets before checking the next word. Add the lengths of all formable words.
constraints: Words and letters contain lowercase English letters.
Each candidate is checked independently against the full inventory.
hints: Each candidate gets a fresh copy of the same letter inventory, but repeated letters inside one word still require repeated supply.
Count available letters once, compare each word's frequency requirements, and add only the lengths of feasible words.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the formable_word_total invariant is complete.
Editorial: Count available letters once, compare each word's frequency requirements, and add only the lengths of feasible words. The intended bounds are O(total characters) time and O(k) space.
